_comment: Shared project settings. tool_guard.py denies bare Rust tools and bare python/pip (use soldr / uv, AGENTS.md); it stays silent under clud, which enforces the same rule. The command anchors on $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and guards on [ -f ] so a checkout without the script cannot wedge the shell.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}" && { [ -f ci/hooks/tool_guard.py ] && uv run --no-project --script ci/hooks/tool_guard.py || exit 0; }
